M-BUN-VERSION-GUARD.Summary: Refuses to run the toolchain on a Bun older than engines.bun in package.json.

M-REVIEW-GATE.Summary: Runs the whole check suite for Spec Kitty's review gate and writes one JUnit report with a test case per check.

M-LOCUS-MODEL.Summary: The Locus, Charter, Relation and Fabric model with Identity checks and deep freezing.

M-LOCUS-VALIDATION.Summary: Validates a Fabric into an ordered list of diagnostics with stable codes.

M-LOCUS-REVISION.Summary: Canonical form, content-addressed Revisions and ordered change sets between two Revisions.

M-LOCUS-HISTORY.Summary: The RevisionHistory service with compare-and-set append and an in-memory layer.

M-LOCUS-DECODE.Summary: Decodes unknown or JSON text input into Fabric and Locus definitions with path-located issues.

M-LOCUS-SPECS.Summary: The executable specification catalogue, its runner, the playground examples and Revision goldens, served from the @telos/locus/specs entry point.

M-DOCS-CONTENT.Summary: Compiles docs/ into the site's content, search index, llms.txt and index.json, failing on any content problem.

M-DOCS-SPEC-REPORT.Summary: Runs the specifications at build time and writes the spec report and build info with provenance, and checks that the built Verification page carries the result.

M-DOCS-SITE.Summary: The prerendered TanStack Start site: layout, navigation, document pages, theme, search, diagrams, verification page and the static server.

M-DOCS-PLAYGROUND.Summary: Scenarios A to E that run the real packages in the browser on decoded input, with provenance and historical marking.
